title: Sewer backup endorsement
text: Sewer or drain backup is eligible for coverage only when the water backup endorsement appears on the declarations. The endorsement covers sudden backup into the dwelling.

title: WB-01 payment schedule
text: WB-01 pays up to $10,000 per occurrence, subject to a $500 deductible.

title: Flood exclusion
text: The base homeowners policy excludes surface flooding, including overflow from a river. Separate flood coverage may be available.

title: Theft of personal property
text: Theft of personal property from the dwelling is covered. The insured must provide a police report.

title: PP-04 scheduled valuables
text: PP-04 caps unscheduled jewelry at $1,500 per occurrence. Items listed individually follow the amount shown on their schedule.

title: Temporary living expenses
text: If a covered loss makes the dwelling uninhabitable, reasonable additional living expenses are reimbursable for up to 12 months.

title: Claim reporting
text: Report a loss as soon as practical. Keep receipts and take reasonable steps to prevent further damage.

title: Vacancy condition
text: Vandalism is excluded after the dwelling has been vacant for more than 60 consecutive days.
